claim: SK-51 is the only skill in the catalog with two owners in the owner column ('UX-01 + ADMIN-01'), directly violating the catalog's own first rule and §0's 'No shared ownership'. No agent anywhere lists SK-51 as owned, so SK-51 has zero owners in §4, one row with two owners in §6, and no accountable party for its acceptance gate.

SK-27 is DORMANT and owned by dormant agent PERF-01, yet it is cited by a P0 in-line item. §2.2 puts every DORMANT skill explicitly out of scope, and §6 repeats it. So the highest-severity item in scope cites an out-of-scope skill. §7 Phase 13 lists the same work without SK-27, which means the range and the phase disagree about whether latency craft is in the build at all — and whether PERF-01 activates.

SK-06 (Claim substantiation, owner COMPL-01) is DORMANT, but two ACTIVE standing agents list it as a skill they execute: SITE-01 'Skills executed: SK-01, SK-06, SK-15, SK-21' and RSCH-01 'Skills executed: SK-06'. Appendix D item 7 confirms SK-06 only comes alive when COMPL-01 activates. Both standing agents run from day one, so they carry an out-of-scope skill in their loadout from Phase 1.

SK-24 is split across three agents: §6 gives it one ACTIVE owner (UX-01), while §4.7 records QUOTE-01 as holding 'SK-24 (intake half)' and MEMBER-01 as holding 'SK-24 (application half)'. That is three holders for a skill the catalog says has exactly one owning agent, and two of the three are DORMANT while the skill is exercised in Phases 13 and 14. Whether the intake/application halves of SK-24's gate ('quote submission completable on a phone in one sitting', which is explicitly CHG-004 work) are in scope or dormant is unresolvable from the text.

SK-34 (Pricing strategy publishing, owner ADMIN-01) is marked ACTIVE but is exercised in no phase of §7 and appears in no Appendix E row, yet it is not in Appendix E's 'Dormant, exercised in no phase' list. It is also attached to no §2.1 item. SK-45 (Severity triage, owner AIM-00) is ACTIVE and is in AIM-00's loadout, but it appears in no phase row of Appendix E — including the 'Continuous' row, which lists only SK-01, SK-02, SK-41, SK-46, SK-50 — and it is not in the dormant list either. §3 makes severity assignment a continuous AIM-00 duty, so the phase index contradicts the catalog and the manager charter about when SK-45 is exercised.

But Phase 18's skills are SK-51, SK-26, SK-49 — SK-52, the adversarial-verification skill that produces the attempted-access matrix SEC-01's gate is defined in terms of, is not exercised until Phase 19, after Phase 18's gate must already have passed.
